sloka: अहम् प्रभाव संपन्ना स्वच्छंद बल गामिनी ।चिराय भव भर्ता मे सीतया किम् करिष्यसि ॥३-१७-२५॥
transliteration: aham prabhāva saṁpannā svacchaṁda bala gāminī ।cirāya bhava bhartā me sītayā kim kariṣyasi ॥3-17-25॥

translations.english: Setting them aside, I came here, as soon as I saw you. You are the finest among men and I am here wishing you to be my husband.
